metadata.audience: Documentation maintainers reconciling duplicated public and contributor claims
metadata.page_job: Identify the canonical source for a repeated concept and choose a safe redirect or bounded projection
metadata.support: maintained as the current documentation authority map
metadata.authority: This map owns concept-to-route authority and redirect policy; each canonical route owns the facts named in its entry
metadata.next_action: Match the duplicated claim to one concept entry, preserve only the allowed projection, and link its canonical route

default.condition: The repeated statement matches a concept entry and the consuming page does not own that concept
default.choice: Replace the repeated explanation with the entry's allowed projection and canonical link
default.outcome: One route remains authoritative while inbound pages retain enough context to navigate
default.change_condition: Keep local prose only when the entry explicitly permits a bounded projection; add or revise an entry before redirecting an unmapped concept
default.proof: A structured read-back resolves the concept to exactly one canonical route and every route and anchor validates

safe_redirect: Name the reader-relevant outcome in one affirmative sentence
Link the canonical route at the point where the fact is needed
Preserve local prerequisites or mode conditions that change whether the link applies
Remove duplicated rationale, implementation history, benchmark numbers, and support promises unless this entry permits them
redirect_contract.bounded_projection: A short local statement is a projection, not a second authority: it must stay within allowed_projection and delegate details and proof to canonical_route
redirect_contract.unmapped_concept: Do not choose an authority by inference. Add an entry with one owner and validate it before rewriting consumers.
redirect_contract.historical_content: Retain historical wording only on a lifecycle-labeled historical or archived route that names the current successor; it cannot override a gen/now authority.
redirect_contract.conflict: When two routes make incompatible current claims, stop the redirect and reconcile the owning evidence before editing projections.

concepts.canonical_owns: The current public definition, value proposition, and top-level system boundary
concepts.allowed_projection: One sentence naming fak as an agent kernel plus a link to the README
concepts.safe_redirect: Read what fak is and why the kernel seam matters
concepts.must_not_duplicate: Competing product definitions or extended architecture rationale

concepts.canonical_owns: The runnable no-key proof commands, expected outcomes, and verification sequence
concepts.allowed_projection: A short promise of the proof outcome and either the canonical command block or a link; copied commands must remain byte-consistent with the canonical route
concepts.must_not_duplicate: A divergent command sequence or different expected result

concepts.allowed_projection: One role-specific link whose label names the destination task
concepts.safe_redirect: Choose the path that matches your role
concepts.must_not_duplicate: A second role taxonomy or exhaustive document inventory

concepts.canonical_owns: Repository operating rules, build questions, guard recovery, and ship discipline for coding agents
concepts.allowed_projection: A link directing coding agents to read AGENTS.md before acting
concepts.must_not_duplicate: A shortened rule set that can drift from enforced behavior

concepts.canonical_owns: The compact machine-oriented map of documentation routes
concepts.allowed_projection: A link identifying llms.txt as the machine-oriented map

concepts.canonical_owns: The exhaustive audience, task, lifecycle, generation, and front-door-link catalog
concepts.allowed_projection: A link labeled as the exhaustive catalog rather than a recommended starting path
concepts.must_not_duplicate: A hand-maintained exhaustive list on a curated front door

concepts.canonical_owns: The supported integration-path choice and route-specific prerequisites
concepts.allowed_projection: A task-specific integration link with the applicable prerequisite
concepts.must_not_duplicate: An unscoped compatibility or support matrix

concepts.canonical_owns: Whether a public claim is shipped, simulated, or a stub and the evidence bound to that status
concepts.allowed_projection: A scoped claim carrying its status tag and a link to the ledger entry
concepts.safe_redirect: Check the claim status and evidence
concepts.must_not_duplicate: An untagged capability promise or stronger status than the ledger

concepts.canonical_owns: Benchmark baseline roles, provenance, and which measured result may support a public performance claim
concepts.allowed_projection: A scoped result with provenance and a link to its authority row
concepts.safe_redirect: Verify the benchmark baseline and provenance
concepts.must_not_duplicate: Detached headline numbers, naive-baseline headlines, or inferred general gains

completion_check: The duplicated claim resolves to exactly one concept entry
The local wording stays within allowed_projection and retains applicable prerequisites or modes
The canonical route owns the delegated fact and its route and anchor resolve
No current claim is delegated to historical or archived content
An independent maintainer can name the concept, canonical source, safe redirect, and next action without guessing
